name: Project Eden
description: Project Eden is a singleplayer and multiplayer third-person squad action-adventure game.

audio_settings.title: Enable EAX
audio_settings.reason: Project Eden only uses EAX reverb and 3D hardware sound when its Reverb and hardware mixing options are on.

optional_settings.title: Set sample rate to 44100 Hz
optional_settings.reason: Project Eden saves its sound sample rate in the registry, and this sets it to CD quality.
